fact: South Sudan's ICT ministry invited international bids (SS-MICT&PS-544330-NC-RFB, bids closing 26 October 2026) for about 397 km of terrestrial fibre on the Juba-Nadapal route toward the Kenyan border, financed under World Bank grant E1780 of the Eastern Africa Regional Digital Integration Project; this is procurement, not yet works, and the notice date is given as the report's 2026-09-14 publication.

The World Bank's June 2026 status report on the Eastern Africa Regional Digital Integration Project lists as a key achievement the signing of the first cross-border digital connectivity MoU between Kenya and South Sudan, a model for the remaining bilateral MoUs; the signing date is not given, so the report's published date is used.
system: Kenya-South Sudan cross-border digital connectivity MoU

fact: A World Bank mission aide-memoire says South Sudan's US$67m Eastern Africa Regional Digital Integration Project is to tender fibre routes from Juba to the Kenya border and to the Sudan border, with the first tender planned for December 2025 and contract award in April 2026.
system: Eastern Africa Regional Digital Integration Project

fact: The PIDA prospectus page records that South Sudan and Kenya signed an agreement at the 30th EACO Assembly for a 2,420 km fibre link into South Sudan, with the Ministry of ICT announcing on 8 August 2025 that construction would begin in early 2026.
